cover.title: Why Roku Sells at a Loss
cover.label: ROKU

lines.text: Roku sells its streaming sticks and TVs at a loss. On purpose.
lines.say: Roku sells its streaming sticks and TVs at a loss. On purpose.

lines.text: In 2025, Roku's devices had $592.4M in sales and an $82.0M gross loss.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-five, Roku's devices had about five hundred ninety-two million dollars in sales, and an eighty-two million dollar gross loss.

lines.text: On average, about $14 lost per $100 of hardware.
lines.say: On average, about fourteen dollars lost per hundred dollars of hardware.

lines.text: The real money is Platform: ads and subscriptions, $4.14B.
lines.say: The real money is Platform: ads and subscriptions, four point one four billion dollars.
That's eighty-seven and a half percent of Roku's revenue.
It's grown from two point seven one billion in twenty twenty-two.

lines.text: Roku sells ads on its home screen and The Roku Channel, plus a cut of subscriptions.
lines.say: Roku sells ads on its home screen and The Roku Channel, plus a cut of subscriptions.

lines.text: In 2025, each $100 of Platform revenue kept about $52 of gross profit.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-five, each hundred dollars of Platform revenue kept about fifty-two dollars of gross profit.

lines.text: So the cheap stick is the doorway.
lines.say: So the cheap stick is the doorway.

lines.text: Fox agreed in June 2026 to buy Roku for about $22B, pending approval.
lines.say: Fox agreed in June twenty twenty-six to buy Roku for about twenty-two billion, pending approval.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Why Roku sells streaming sticks at a loss
post.ig:
Roku sells its streaming sticks and TVs at a loss. On purpose.
In 2025, Roku's Devices segment had $592.4M in revenue and an $82.0M gross loss (FY2025 10-K).
Its Platform segment, ads and subscriptions, made $4.14B, 87.5% of revenue, with about a 52% gross margin.
Platform revenue grew from $2.71B in 2022 to $4.14B in 2025. Fox agreed in June 2026 to buy Roku in a deal valued at about $22B, pending regulatory approval.
Sources: Roku FY2025 and FY2022 10-Ks, Variety.
News and education, not financial advice.
